summary: The registrant filed an 8-K on Item 8.01 to report the termination of its At-the-Market (ATM) offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright, effective June 11, 2026. The original agreement was dated January 7, 2026, for the sale of Class A common stock. No shares were sold under the ATM, and no other material corporate event is disclosed. This is a routine operational decision to cease at-the-market sales, not a special situation. No deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation are mentioned. No further action or catalyst is expected.
